name: Astrocade
tagline: Create and play AI-generated games from a prompt.
description: Astrocade is an AI-native platform for creating and playing games without code. Describe an idea and its AI generates playable experiences — handling art, animation, music, sound, and gameplay logic — then publishes them to a social feed where others can discover and play. Founded by brothers Amir and Ali Sadeghian, it reached over 20 million users within eight months of launch.
insight: Raised $56M across Series A/B (Sequoia led the B, Sea Limited the A), backed by Google's AI fund and Nvidia.
edge: Generates the whole game — art, animation, music, and mechanics — from a single prompt, then ships it to a built-in social play feed.
pros: Full game generation from a prompt
Backed by Sequoia, Google, and Nvidia
